classification.default-on-ready: every blind and temporal default-on gate passes
classification.failed: blind target gate fails or an integrity error occurs
classification.improved-opt-in-only: blind target gate passes but any default-on gate fails
classification.insufficient-evidence: population exhausted below support or temporal canary cannot complete

sampling.checkpoint_receipt: atomically seal all 28 advertised default refs, heads, capture times, command provenance, and errors before any nose replay or verdict
sampling.cutoff: the earliest fixed checkpoint whose complete selected population reaches at least 1000 changes

eligibility.range: sealed pinned_head_at_seal exclusive through checkpoint default HEAD inclusive

sampling.errors: selection, ancestry, identity, or checkpoint errors force the failed verdict; query errors remain counted and are never replaced
sampling.exhaustion: if no fixed checkpoint through day 180 reaches 1000 selected changes, verdict is insufficient-evidence

first_parent_ancestry.requirement: pinned_head_at_seal must appear as an exact output line; ordinary graph ancestry or a second-parent-only merge is insufficient

row_hmac.canonical_identity: UTF-8 JSON of repository, commit, parent with sorted keys, no whitespace, ensure_ascii=false

sampling.remote_head: at each checkpoint, resolve the same repository URL's advertised default HEAD; require the sealed head to occur on the checkpoint head's first-parent chain
sampling.sealed_head: during freeze, resolve and privately commit the repository URL's actual advertised default ref and HEAD; the corpus commit is not used as the temporal cutoff
sampling.selection: at each checkpoint, take the first 40 eligible changes per repository by the frozen HMAC tuple below; include every selected change from every reserve repository
sampling.unit: one first-parent PR/change after the sealed repository head

privacy.public_identity: HMAC-derived opaque repository/change ids and row commitments

advisory_arm.command: nose query . base=<parent> top=0 --format json --mode syntax,semantic,near

objective_order: maximize strict target precision lower confidence bound
use strict recall only as a tie-breaker

precision.change: changes with at least one should-propagate strict target / changes with at least one strict target
precision.finding: positive strict findings / all adjudicated strict findings
precision.target: should-propagate strict targets / all adjudicated strict targets

primary_arm.command: nose query . base=<parent> top=0 --format json --mode syntax,semantic

units.change: one repository first-parent commit; a true block has at least one should-propagate strict target
units.finding: one emitted family finding; positive when at least one direct strict target should propagate
units.target: one direct changed-member to skipped-sibling propagation edge

git_environment.ambient_git_environment: all inherited GIT_* variables are removed before fixed overrides
git_environment.path_and_diff_encoding: raw bytes encoded as base64 in the private packet
git_environment.repository_view: fresh local bare --shared mirror; source local config and info attributes are not inherited

sampling_stop_rule.errors: A failed replay remains in its repository and cannot be replaced by another change.
sampling_stop_rule.exhaustion: If all 28 sealed blind repositories are exhausted before every aggregate and per-language support minimum is met, verdict is insufficient-evidence.
sampling_stop_rule.ordering: secret HMAC repository order, then secret HMAC change order
procedure: run the frozen binary and primary arm over every change of the next repository
adjudicate every emitted strict finding and target from that complete repository
stop only after a complete repository brings cumulative support to at least 100 strict findings, 100 strict targets, 20 complete repositories, and 2 complete repositories in every supported language
never select, discard, or stop within a repository, change, finding, or target

rubric.identity: opaque target id only until all raw verdicts and resolution are sealed

verdict_protocol.seal_transition: raw reviewer verdicts are frozen atomically, then disagreements are resolved, then identities may be revealed once
